entities.name: Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: Angel Commander of the Serra Angels of the Order of Dawn and Protector of Benalia on Dominaria.

entities.name: Order of Dawn
entities.description: Order of Serra Angels led by Lyra.

entities.name: Reya Dawnbringer
entities.description: Famous angel who died defending Benalia during the Phyrexian Invasion.

entities.name: Benalia
entities.description: Nation on Dominaria that Lyra protects.

entities.name: Gideon
entities.description: Planeswalker who sought entry to Benalia City to kill Belzenlok.

entities.name: Liliana
entities.description: Necromancer planeswalker whom Lyra initially barred from Benalia City.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: Target Gideon and Liliana were going to kill.

entities.name: Rael
entities.description: Sent a letter of recommendation explaining the planeswalkers' help.

entities.name: Orvada
entities.description: Neighbouring merchant nation with which Benalia made peace.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: War in which Lyra led Benalish forces on the front lines.

entities.name: Echoverse Lyra Dawnbringer
entities.description: In the Echoverse, Lyra is headmaster of the Tolarian Academy.

entities.name: Tolarian Academy
entities.description: Academy led by Lyra in the Echoverse.

events.summary: Lyra bars Gideon and Liliana at the gates of Benalia City, saying the necromancer cannot enter.
events.quote: Lyra barred the entrance of Gideon and Liliana at the gates of the Benalia City

events.summary: After Rael's letter of recommendation, Lyra lets Liliana into the city.
events.quote: Lyra agreed with Liliana's entry into the city.

events.summary: Lyra negotiates a new peace between Benalia and Orvada.
events.quote: had negotiated a new peace between Benalia and the neighbouring merchant nation of Orvada

events.summary: During the New Phyrexian Invasion Lyra leads Benalish forces on the front lines.
events.quote: During the New Phyrexian Invasion , she was on the front lines, leading the Benalish forces.

events.summary: Danitha Capashen gives Lyra an honorary knighthood after victory.
events.quote: Lyra received an honorary knighthood from Danitha Capashen

relations.quote: Lyra is the leader of the Order of Dawn on Dominaria

relations.note: Lyra continues Reya's mission; the order is named for Reya.
relations.quote: Now Lyra continues Reya's mission of protecting Benalia
